limitations: Ghidra pseudocode, imported Qt behavior, and C++ ABI argument interpretation remain bounded observations. The original DLL was not executed.
The source map includes complete bytes only for the selected function bodies and one related read-only metadata/string region. It does not claim whole-DLL coverage.
Internal helper labels FUN_180002580, FUN_180001e60, and FUN_1800017b0 are Ghidra function database labels. They are not original exports or source names.
Assembly renderer text is provider-specific. Exact string equality between dossier assembly and separate assembly is not a required invariant.
